open_points.subject: credential echo detection in service file responses
open_points.text: “one that carries it … inside a file the kernel only moves, cannot be recognised” contradicts A09 rule 7: “Every body as read … is searched … for the bytes of the credential value”
open_points.question: Must service_invoker search a file-output response body for a verbatim credential before spooling it, or are file bodies exempt from credential-echo detection?
options: Search every response body, including file outputs
open_points.default_guess: Search every response body, including file outputs, because service_invoker already owns credential-echo withholding before an output is created.

open_points.subject: exclusive reverse-proxy access to the MCP listener
open_points.text: “The proxy terminates TLS and is the only client of the kernel's listener, whose address the installation names and which the host does not expose otherwise”
open_points.question: Who owns or enforces the requirement that the configured listener is reachable only by the reverse proxy: an explicit host/deployment obligation outside the kernel, installation validation of permitted listen addresses, or a runtime check by another module?
options: installation validates a proxy-only listen address
surface authenticates or verifies the proxy
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as an explicit host/deployment obligation outside the running kernel, with no runtime module enforcing it.
